subject: MAP: Technical evaluation milestones & target close — Clinova Labs
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@clinovalabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2025-07-15T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation milestones & target close — Clinova Labs

Hi Samantha,

Great to meet with you and the product team today — thanks for the time. Per our call, I’m sending a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft focused on the technical evaluation milestone we discussed. I’ve attached a working MAP and a starter benchmark slate for your review (attachments below).

Key MAP milestone — Technical evaluation (owner & expectations):
- Success criteria: accuracy on internal test set >= 92% (top-line metric), safety/regression pass on the toxicity checklist, and P95 latency <= 250ms for 512-token prompts.
- Cost target: model + infra cost <= $0.60 per 1k tokens for steady-state inference (we can adjust with batching/quantization).
- Shortlist: Llama-3-13B-q4 (fast quantized), Mistral-Instruct-7B (instruction-tuned), Falcon-40B-v2-compat (higher-quality fallthrough).

Proposed milestone timeline (technical evaluation):
- Week 0 (this week): onboarding + data access — Clinova provides sample test set (anonymized) + S3 read role.
- Week 1: harness & baseline runs (Karthik owns) — ensure reproducible scripts, seed, and metric definitions.
- Week 2: full benchmark runs and latency profiling across target p95/throughput points.
- Week 3: analysis, quality trade-off review, and recommended model/profile for pilot.

Owners (Redwood / Clinova):
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (benchmark exec, infra config), Marissa Cole (trial ops & access), Jonas Weber (deployment/config support).
- Clinova: Samantha Lin (product lead, dataset steward), named CTO contact for infra/SSO (asked to loop Eric).

Dependencies / blockers we flagged on the call:
- Clinova provides an anonymized sample dataset and confirms data handling constraints (PII redaction).
- Temporary test credentials or S3 role for Redwood benchmark runs.
- SOC2 evidence + security questionnaire answers for deeper enterprise review (we can provide SOC2 report link once NDA signed).

Target close date for the MAP (commercial + technical acceptance): 2025-09-30 — this is our suggested target; we can move it if your procurement timeline needs it.

Next steps (action items):
1) Samantha: share sample dataset and confirm who will sign the limited data access form (due by 2025-07-18).
2) Redwood (Marissa): send details for S3 role and test environment by 2025-07-17.
3) Redwood (Karthik): baseline harness and expected metric computation notebook by 2025-07-20.
4) Schedule benchmark kickoff (30–45m) — suggest 2025-07-21 or 2025-07-22.

Attachments: MAP_Clinova_v1.xlsx (MAP milestones + owners), benchmark_slate.csv (initial model/metric list).

If anything here looks off or you want different success metrics, flag them and we’ll update the MAP. Thanks again — looking forward to getting the harness running.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.inference.com
From: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@clinovalabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Eric Zhou <eric.zhou@clinovalabs.com>
Date: 2025-07-15T18:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation milestones & target close — Clinova Labs

Thanks Ava — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. I’ve looped Eric (CTO) on the thread so he can weigh in on infra and SSO. A couple of quick clarifications from our side:

- Dataset: we can produce a 10k-row anonymized test set but need confirmation on the exact columns you need redacted (we will not share free-text PHI).
- Cost target: $0.60/1k tokens sounds reasonable as a long-term target; for the PoC we may accept a higher per-token during profiling if it helps understand quality trade-offs.
- Timeline: our procurement cycle is a bit pushed — could we consider moving the MAP target close to 2025-10-15 instead of 2025-09-30? We should still try to keep the technical evaluation timeline tight.

Eric — can you confirm SSO/role creation for an S3 read role?

I’ll aim to have the dataset requirements and legal contact for the limited data access form by EOD 2025-07-17.

— Samantha
Product Lead, Clinova Labs
samantha.lin@clinovalabs.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@clinovalabs.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2025-07-16T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation milestones & target close — Clinova Labs

Hi Samantha / Ava —

Thanks for the quick review and the timeline note. Happy to own the benchmark execution. A few technical clarifications and commitments so the MAP can be made actionable:

Benchmark plan (more detail):
- Harness: we’ll provide a Docker-based harness + reproducible runbook (seeded runs, metric calculators) by 2025-07-20.
- Metrics: exact-match, F1 (where applicable), calibration (confidence vs correctness), and latency p50/p95 at 1, 4, and 8 concurrent qps targets.
- Cost calc: we’ll provide per-model estimated cost examples using both continuous batching and the quantized execution path — will show delta graphs (cost vs quality).

Model shortlist rationale and fallback order:
1) Llama-3-13B-q4 — target for fastest runs and lowest cost; expected to meet latency target on our dedicated hit.
2) Mistral-Instruct-7B — strong instruction-following baseline with good cost profile.
3) Falcon-40B-v2-compat — higher quality fallback if the smaller models fail acceptance.

Immediate asks from Clinova (to unblock Week 0):
- Confirm dataset schema and identify columns to redact (Samantha).
- Provide a short-lived S3 role/credentials or a secure transfer link for the anonymized sample.
- Point of contact for infra/SAML details (Eric).

Owners (explicit):
- Benchmark execution: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com).
- Trial orchestration & credentials: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com).
- MAP/comms and commercial: Ava Chen.
- Deployment tuning & perf triage: Jonas Weber.

We’ll attach the harness and a short checklist in the shared drive; I’ve also attached the initial benchmark_slate.csv to this thread. Proposed time for kickoff: 2025-07-22 10:00 PT — if that works for Clinova, we’ll put it on the calendar.

> On Jul 15, 2025, at 15:05, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> > Key MAP milestone — Technical evaluation (owner & expectations):
> > - Success criteria: accuracy on internal test set >= 92%...
>
Looking forward to the run — I’ll start prepping the harness today.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@clinovalabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.inference.com>

Thanks Karthik — that all looks good. 2025-07-22 10:00 PT works for our team; I’ll have the dataset schema and the legal contact for the limited access form to you by 2025-07-17 as promised. Eric confirmed he can provision an S3 role for a short-lived read-only principal (he’ll send details).

We’re comfortable moving the MAP target close to 2025-10-15 for procurement reasons but will aim to finish the technical acceptance earlier if possible. I’ll add the kickoff invite once Eric’s SSO details are in this thread.

— Samantha
Product Lead, Clinova Labs
